import time, random
n=22
# 64 dims packed
items=[]
for i in range(n):
    x=0
    for j in random.sample(range(64),9): x += 1<<(6*j)
    items.append(x)
caps=sum(random.randrange(0,12)<<(6*j) for j in range(64))
H=sum(1<<(6*j+5) for j in range(64))
CU=caps|H
benefits=[random.randrange(1,10**9) for _ in range(n)]
start=time.perf_counter(); usage=0;ben=0;cnt=0;best=-1;bestc=99;bests=0
for i in range(1,1<<n):
    lsb=i&-i;j=lsb.bit_length()-1
    g=i^(i>>1)
    it=items[j];bb=benefits[j]
    if g&lsb: usage+=it;ben+=bb;cnt+=1
    else: usage-=it;ben-=bb;cnt-=1
    if ((CU-usage)&H)==H:
        if ben>best or (ben==best and cnt<bestc): best=ben;bestc=cnt;bests=i
print(time.perf_counter()-start,best,bestc)
